info.syllabusName: Fundamental of Graphic design _Nguyên lý đồ hoạ cơ bản
info.description:
This course provides students with knowledge of visual arts principles

By the end of this course, students will be able to:

1. Understand basic design and visual rules to lay out the composition of art works

2. Analyze, evaluate the effect of design elements in each composition

4. Understand and apply 5 rules of design principles on contemporary artworks (Unity & Harmony, Balance, Scale & Proportion, Contrast & Emphasis, Rhythm)

4. Define the beauty of nature and analyze how it inspires designers to art works

5. Apply visual principles in doing excersises and making art works during career

6. Use drawing tools more effectively with both hand drawing and digital artworks.

6. Plan and organize visual products in the most effective way
info.studentTasks:
1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend more than 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

2. Actively participate in class activities

3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

5. Read the textbook in advance

6. Access the course website (http://cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.
